mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ha_service_instance ( service_name, host, port, serve_as_master, expire_at, instance_status, metadata, last_heartbeat ) VALUES ( #{serviceName}, #{host}, #{port}, #{serveAsMaster}, #{expireAt}, #{instanceStatus}, #{metadata}, #{lastHeartbeat} ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE expire_at = #{expireAt}, instance_status = #{instanceStatus}, metadata = #{metadata}, last_heartbeat = #{lastHeartbeat}, updated_at = NOW()
